title: Bitcoin AI Model Review — Week 42: 0 of 5 Calls Correct
meta_description: Week 42 graded: 0 of 5 Bitcoin calls correct (0%). All-time: 39.7% over 73 public calls. Paper portfolio +15.3% vs holding.

intro: Welcome to the QuantAura Signals weekly recap for the period of 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16.
This week the model posted a clean sweep of losses, finishing with 0 hits out of 5 resolved calls for an accuracy rate of 0.0 percent.
That active 5 call miss streak marks a severe slump on our ledger, leaving no room for spin.
days: Looking past Monday, Tuesday brought another hold signal at 54.3 percent confidence while the market dropped 2.2 percent.
On Wednesday the system pivoted aggressively, issuing a sell call with 80.7 percent confidence, but Bitcoin ticked upward by 0.76 percent to break the signal.
Thursday and Friday both saw consecutive sell recommendations at 69.3 percent and 63 percent confidence.
Because the market moved down only 0.73 percent on Thursday and 0.53 percent on Friday, both moves stayed within the 1.0 percent flat band and registered as misses.
spotlight: The most notable failure of the week arrived on Monday, where the model started the run with a hold call.
Confidence sat at 60.5 percent heading into the 24 hour evaluation horizon.
Instead of holding steady within the threshold, Bitcoin dropped 2.63 percent, resulting in a plain and decisive miss.
The model misread both the direction and the volatility right from the opening bell.
trend: Across the entire week, Bitcoin experienced steady downward pressure punctuated by a brief mid-week bounce.
The model reacted to this environment by issuing holds during the steeper drops and switching to sell signals right as price movement compressed.
Every single call sat on the wrong side of the daily price shifts.
portfolio: Our paper portfolio tracks an initial balance of 10000.0 dollars over 75 days of active tracking.
The strategy currently sits entirely in cash at 11534.34 dollars, representing a gain of 15.34 percent after deducting 129.36 dollars in trading fees from 8 trades.
A simple buy and hold approach over the same duration reached 12495.85 dollars, delivering a return of 24.96 percent.
That leaves the signal strategy trailing buy and hold by negative 9.62 percent, demonstrating that following these calls underperformed passive ownership.
record: Over our entire published history, the model holds 29 hits and 44 misses across 73 resolved calls, establishing an all-time accuracy of 39.7 percent.
The sell signal remains particularly defective, achieving an accuracy of just 11.5 percent over 26 instances.
That record keeps the system well below a coin flip, though the overall sample remains an early baseline.

research.title: Why the model predicts regimes, not prices
paragraphs: The model does not predict prices. It classifies the next twenty four hours into an upward, downward, or flat regime.
Exact price targets are noise at this horizon. Regimes are the part of the problem a model can actually learn.
Ask a model for a number it cannot know and it will hand you one anyway. We would rather ask it a question it can answer.
